Scottish '''flapjacks''' are a type of baked bar dessert made with oats.

== Ingredients ==
* 75 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] or [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]
* 50–75 g light [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Golden Syrup|golden syrup]]
* 175 g porridge [[Cookbook:Oats|oats]]

== Procedure ==
# Put the butter or margarine, sugar, and golden syrup into a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], and stir over a low heat until the fat and sugar have melted.
# Add the porridge oats and blend thoroughly.
# Press into a well-greased 18 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]] square [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|sandwich tin]].
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the centre of a moderate [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] at 180°C (350°F / gas mark 4) for 25 minutes or until evenly golden brown.
# Cut into rectangles in the tin whilst warm.
# Allow to become almost cold in the tin before removing.
# Enjoy!

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* Replace the sugar and golden syrup with 75 g of [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]].
* Add 50 g of [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisins]].
